summary: An ADAPTER for stack-kit, the manifest-driven build and delivery kit: the one published declaration that carries its name. It brings a detector that reads the commands a host declares in `stack-kit.json` (`commands.test`, `commands.build`), so the briefing every runtime reads says how a change is built and proven. An ordinary capability, taken like any adapter; no interpreter in the kit knows that it exists. It is also the BRIDGE for secrets (one catalogue, two judges): stack-kit's `scan` (tree and history, in CI) reads the secrets policy's calibrated edit-gate document by the path a host declares in `stack-kit.json` under `security.secretPatterns` -- `policies/secrets/payload/edit-gates.json` as published (`.agents/taken/secrets/payload/edit-gates.json` in a vendored host), contract `kit/schemas/edit-gate.schema.json` (gates[].paths, forbids, proves, admits) -- so the edit hook, the commit gate and the scan judge one list. A claim about stack-kit until a scan is observed reading it.
